About.title: About Me
About.greeting: Hey there — thanks for stopping by! 👋
About.bio_p1: I'm Mariia Synelnyk, a Full-Stack Developer with over 5 years of experience building fast, intuitive, and scalable applications. My focus lies at the intersection of robust backend logic and seamless user experiences.
About.bio_p2: With a background spanning high-concurrency Java backends (Spring Boot/Hibernate) and modern React ecosystems, I've scaled products across domains like Legal Tech and E-commerce. I also spent 2 years deep-diving into Web3, developing and auditing smart contracts in Solidity and Rust for Ethereum and Solana.
About.bio_p3: Currently, I'm focused on the Legal Tech space, utilizing GraphQL and Next.js to build impactful software. I believe great software is born from curiosity, clean code, and a strong product mindset—always aiming for performance, usability, and long-term maintainability.
About.work_status: Open to work full time in Germany
